verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that GitLab's GitHub importer brings over repository data, issues, pull requests, wikis, milestones, labels and comments. A third-party partner (Relokia) also offers migration of project-management data between GitLab and tools like Jira and GitHub. There is no first-party documentation of the import tooling, and nothing shows users being migrated or self-hosted instances moving to GitLab.com. Missing for 10: first-party importer documentation, self-hosted-to-cloud migration tooling, user/membership migration, importers for platforms beyond GitHub, recent hands-on corroboration.
